title: Rung: Riemannian geometry from non-uniform redistribution

statements.text: When redistribution is non-uniform no single inertial frame stays globally adequate, so a metric, a metric-compatible torsion-free connection and curvature become the minimal structure for comparing neighboring domains.

sources.quote: the metric enters precisely at the point where global comparison becomes unstable under non-uniform redistribution.
Curvature appears where local comparison structure cannot be extended globally without mismatch.
